function: no_learning (p. 10): the DNN only predicts OP, ASER, EC, Rmax and Pmin from system parameters; IRS selection (max SNR, p. 6) and power (KKT, p. 10) are not learned.
notes: Excluded with code no_learning, the first code that applies. The physical-layer functions of the work are not learned: the opportunistic scheme selects the IRS with the maximum end-to-end SNR (p. 6, eq. (6)), the IRSs reflect coherently toward D under full reflection (p. 5-6), and the transmit power of the rate-maximization and power-minimization problems is obtained in closed form from the KKT conditions (p. 10, eqs. (52) and (58)). The DNN is a surrogate that assesses performance, p. 10: "DNN framework designed for forecasting the OP, ASER, EC, and optimization problems for OIS"; its 10 inputs are Pt (or Rth), N, the dGG shaping parameters and the distances of two IRSs, with no instantaneous channel (Table IV, p. 11); its single output is a value produced by Monte-Carlo simulation or by the optimization solver (p. 10-11), and it is judged only by MSE and execution time against simulation (Table VI, p. 16). p. 17: "a DNN framework was also designed to evaluate the proposed system". If the regression itself were read as the learned function, performance prediction is outside the seven areas, so code function would also exclude it. System: single-antenna source and destination vehicles with L passive IRSs, 6 GHz (p. 5, p. 12). The PDF is the paper of the DOI (title and DOI on p. 1).
